title_o: An Open Pilot Study of Training Hostile Interpretation Bias to Treat Disruptive Mood Dysregulation Disorder

replications.quote: Youth with DMDD had a lower inflection point, indicating that they switched their judgment from predominantly happy to predominantly angry earlier along the face morph continuum (participants with DMDD: b[SE] = 7.65[0.06]; healthy volunteers: b[SE] = 8.33[0.08]; t(50) = −6.806, p < .001)
